originalBug: normalize.py sourced gate.targetID from callback target in the expected oracle. A wrong-target successful or empty interval could therefore be assigned expected target identity.
correction: Read actual iOS step.action.target.identifier or step.action.identifier; Android step.selector.identifier. Preserve actual selector candidates and refs. Compare to expected target only as validation. Require raw step.state_id to match explicit mapped trigger_state_id and binding_after.fixture_index to match mapped input_index. Missing, contradictory or mismatched proof leaves behavior U. Caller replacement instead requires actual caller_fixture_update method and native binding index advance.
callbackIndependence: Immediate callbacks use actual immediate binding_after and immutable callback helper interval, independent of later full/target state viewport availability.
attribution: Common evaluator infrastructure correction, no v5 treatment credit. Attribution overlay is separate from fixed grades and does not rescore rows.
